checks: Human recipient granted the synthetic game application permission through normal Security UI and explicit consent.

Game peer decrypted the exact new human reply using its own Signal device keys: one new encrypted reply.
Human paused game messaging permission through the Security switch. The next peer send failed with http_403:FORBIDDEN.

remaining: Peer is a developer game client, not a second complete HiChat UI.
